decision_tree.how_to_read: Fixed question order (the category's most-used filters). Each node shows how many models remain; dead_end:true = that answer leaves 0. Models with several values appear under each, so counts can exceed the parent. Branches stop at <=3 models and list the SKUs.

finder_guide.note: recommended_questions = the strongest filters for a guided finder (most-used Merkmale first). skip_single_value lists Merkmale with only one value across the category – not useful as a finder question. A finder narrows models by matching answers against each product's characteristics.
